name: minio-conditional
fault_model: network loss/delay, client abandon; owner up (no owner crash or reboot)
notes: Run with: python3 evicon_review.py measure minio (release 067: MinIO on VM-B through docker compose with credentials from VM-C's environment or random ones for the measurement, passed on stdin; the fault proxy runs inside the probe on VM-C). The bucket is versioned: every effect is an object version. Release 070: P5 retries the same identity after beyond_gap_s = 600 s, so the measured D_h lower bound is 600 s instead of P4's 2 s (a declared unbounded horizon can never be shown by a finite probe); adds about 10 minutes per repetition.
